name: Filesystem MCP
description: Read, write, list, and manage files and directories on the local filesystem. Supports operations like read_file, write_file, list_directory, create_directory, move_file, search_files, and get_file_info.

name: Brave Search MCP
description: Search the web using Brave Search API. Returns relevant web pages, snippets, and URLs for a given query. Supports both web search and local search.

name: Fetch MCP
description: Fetch and extract content from URLs. Converts web pages to markdown or plain text for processing. Supports HTTP GET requests with customizable headers.

name: GitHub MCP
description: Interact with GitHub repositories and issues. Create repos, manage files, handle issues and pull requests, search code, and manage branches.

name: PostgreSQL MCP
description: Connect to and query PostgreSQL databases. Execute SQL queries, list tables, describe schemas, and perform database operations.

name: SQLite MCP
description: Interact with SQLite databases. Execute SQL queries, create tables, insert data, and manage local database files.

name: Memory MCP
description: Persistent memory storage using a knowledge graph. Store and retrieve entities, relations, and observations across sessions.

name: Puppeteer MCP
description: Browser automation using Puppeteer. Navigate web pages, take screenshots, click elements, fill forms, and execute JavaScript in a headless browser.

name: Slack MCP
description: Interact with Slack workspaces. Send messages, read channels, manage conversations, and search message history.

name: Calculator MCP
description: Perform mathematical calculations. Supports arithmetic, scientific functions, unit conversions, and expression evaluation.
